node.title: KoalaBear m2 V4 outer-recurrence router
node.closure: exact V4 component-stabilizer law, complete primitive degree-30 exclusion, recurrence ledger, and coordinate-stabilized source-star parity
node.statement: For the three residual inner-degree-two transverse types, h x h is the V4 quotient and delta is exactly the order of the setwise stabilizer of the actual bidegree-(4,4) component: full V4 for (r,delta)=(2,4), one of three order-two subgroups for (4,2), and trivial for (8,1). The complete primitive degree-30 catalogue has only subdegrees 1,29, so every outer map decomposes; all proper-factor destinations are impossible or recurrent to m=2. If tau x 1 stabilizes the component, the actual source lift is (tau,b), paired source rows avoid both paired locators, and the source-star weight-three defect is impossible. No m2 type, owner charge, or prize row is closed.
